map.如何使用草坪（修剪/养护）周期？: How do I use Lawn Care Cycle?
map.草坪（修剪/养护）周期适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Lawn Care Cycle best for?
map.管理草坪修剪、施肥、浇水、打孔、除草等养护周期。选择草坪类型（冷季型/暖季型）自: Manage lawn mowing, fertilizing, watering, aerating and weeding cycles. Choose the lawn type (cool-season / warm-season) to generate a care calendar automatically, track the last maintenance date and compute the next care time.
map.暂无草坪，请先添加: No lawn yet; add one first
map.不同草坪类型的四季养护重点参考: Seasonal care highlights for each lawn type
map.养护周期为通用参考，实际需结合草种品种、气候、土壤和草坪使用强度调整: Care cycles are general guidelines; adjust them to the grass variety, climate, soil and how intensively the lawn is used
map.冷季型草坪(高羊茅/早熟禾)春秋为生长旺季，夏季需谨慎养护防病害: Cool-season lawns (tall fescue / Kentucky bluegrass) grow fastest in spring and autumn and need careful summer care against disease
map.暖季型草坪(狗牙根/结缕草)夏季为生长旺季，冬季休眠需停止施肥修剪: Warm-season lawns (Bermuda / zoysia) grow fastest in summer and go dormant in winter, when fertilizing and mowing should stop
map.修剪遵循「三分之一原则」：每次修剪不超过草高的三分之一: Follow the "one-third rule" for mowing: never cut more than one-third of the grass height at a time
map.点击「完成」可快速记录当日维护，自动更新下次到期时间: Click "Done" to quickly log today's maintenance and update the next due time automatically
map.按草坪类型（暖季/冷季）与起始日期，排定修剪、施肥、浇水等养护任务的时间表。: Based on the lawn type (warm/cool season) and start date, schedule mowing, fertilizing, watering and other care tasks.
map.庭院养护季开始前生成整季计划，避免漏掉关键养护节点。: Generate a full-season plan before the care season starts so no key care milestone is missed.
map.记录每次实际养护日期，与计划对照，据此调整后续频率。: Log the actual care date each time and compare it with the plan to adjust the frequency going forward.
map.暖季型草坪在生长旺季修剪频率更高、施肥周期更短；冷季型草坪在高温期需降低修剪频率: Warm-season lawns are mowed more often and fertilized on a shorter cycle during the peak growing season; cool-season lawns need less frequent mowing and adjusted fertilizing during the hot period, and the page applies different task frequencies by lawn type to avoid using one plan for both grasses.
map.按起始日期排出首月计划: Scheduling the first month from the start date
map.设定起始日期后，页面按各任务的周期依次推算出下次养护日期；把实际执行日期回填后，: After setting the start date, the page works out the next care date for each task from its cycle; once you backfill the actual date, the plan rolls forward from the most recent record.
map.草坪与养护记录保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传；换设备或清理浏览器数据后需重新录入: Lawns and care records are stored in local browser storage and never uploaded; changing devices or clearing browser data means re-entering them.
map.暖季和冷季怎么选？: How do I choose warm season or cool season?
map.按所种草种选择：结缕草、狗牙根等属暖季型，早熟禾、黑麦草等属冷季型；不确定时可先: Choose by the grass you planted: zoysia, Bermuda and similar are warm-season, while Kentucky bluegrass, ryegrass and similar are cool-season; if unsure, judge by your local climate and the grass instructions.
map.页面按内置任务（修剪、施肥、浇水等）生成周期，暂不支持自定义新任务；可在记录备注: The page generates cycles from built-in tasks (mowing, fertilizing, watering and so on) and does not yet support custom new tasks; you can note personalized arrangements in the record remarks.
map.草坪养护周期管理工具。支持添加多个草坪区域并区分冷季型/暖季型，自动生成修剪、施: A lawn-care cycle management tool. It supports adding several lawn areas with a cool-season/warm-season distinction, automatically generating schedules and countdowns for five care tasks (mowing, fertilizing, watering, aerating and weeding), with a built-in seasonal care calendar and per-maintenance records, helping gardeners and property managers keep a sensible lawn-care rhythm.
